newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks finish marginally higher.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks finish marginally higher.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended marginally higher amid demand for retail and industrial shares.
Bogota's IBB index rose 0.25 percent to 1,029.77 with volume of 873 million pesos, while Medellin's IBOMED general price index gained 0.46 percent to close at 16,042.95 in 5.1 billion peso trade.
One broker said most investors were holding back until after stockholder meetings planned for March, in which corporate plans will be announced for the rest of 1997.
"Each stock will react on the basis of what is decided at those meetings," the broker said.

The most-favored share of the day on both exchanges was cement manufacturer Cemento Argos. In Bogota, it rose 2.85 percent to 7,200 in volume of 349 million pesos, while in Medellin it gained 2.13 percent to close at 7,200 in 1.15 billion peso volume.
A 3.3 billion peso cross deal in supermarket chain Almacenes Exito pushed the share up 3.45 percent to 3,300.
On the Bogota exchange, Banco Bancoquia rose 1.06 percent to 2,850, while brewing giant Bavaria drifted down 0.05 percent to 6,696.
